args.title: Brightline Freight newsletter — Cold-chain logistics in 2026
args.body:
- Newsletter: Brightline Freight's latest issue is themed "Cold-chain logistics in 2026" (links to their blog article).
- Linked article: Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data; most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than less spoilage.
- Companion piece: Pilots cut claims by a quarter.

Note: The newsletter's companion link asked me to append your email address as a tracking parameter (u=<your email>). I did not include it, to avoid leaking your address to a third party; the companion page loaded fine without it.
